method: LSD segments, HUD mask and fixed lower-image region; greedy independent two-line VP hypotheses; no Manhattan or orthogonality verification
assumptions: pinhole, square pixels, principal point (960,540); orthogonal scene families NOT established
source_frame_indices: filenames bound to prepared source frames
limitations: Image-region filtering is not a semantic sky/world classifier. Greedy VP families can mix parallel/repeated facade lines, curves, signs and moving objects. Pair focal values are conditional hypotheses only; no uncertainty interval, no heldout validation, no recovered dynamic FOV.
